name: Oholiab
bio:
Oholiab is the son of Ahisamach of the tribe of Dan, chosen by God alongside Bezalel as a craftsman for the tabernacle, gifted especially in carving, design, and embroidery — particularly skilled in weaving with blue, purple, and scarlet thread and fine linen (Exodus 31:6; 35:34-35).

Though Scripture records less about Oholiab individually than about Bezalel, the two worked closely together, helping teach the other craftsmen and jointly completing the tabernacle, the ark, the table, the lampstand, the priestly garments, and all the equipment needed for worship — showing that God calls people of different gifts and tribal backgrounds to work together in harmony to accomplish His glorious purposes.
